summary: Single-component architecture (ARCH-001) covers REQ-001..004 with a clear responsibility, a credible approach for the stdlib-only constraint, and justified trade-offs. No inter-component interfaces exist, so the empty interface and integration strategy are consistent. Only minor precision gaps remain.

checklist.item: Every requirement realised by a component
checklist.note: All four REQs map to ARCH-001 at src/textstats/sentences.py.
The public API sentence_stats(text: str) -> tuple[int, float] and the __init__ re-export are not listed as an interface; they appear only in ASM-001 and the tradeoffs (F-1).
None needed for a single pure function.
REQ-004 is addressed by using only re and adding no pyproject dependency.

The regex choice and module layout are reasoned. The regex handles consecutive terminators and a trailing unterminated tail (ASM-002/003), and the word-less segment rule is covered by the responsibility text and ASM-003.
No component interfaces; unit and system tests cover the public function.

findings.description: Record the public function sentence_stats(text: str) -> tuple[int, float] (raises TypeError for non-str) and the textstats package re-export as an entry in architecture 'interfaces', so G3 designs and the tests have an explicit contract.
The regex decision text does not state that segments with zero words are skipped, although ASM-003 requires it. State it in the G3 design.
